# 1. Select and Clean Data

### Load packages and data

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(skimr)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggiraph)

WPE = read_csv("C:/Users/user/Documents/dsml/data/key-features-of-womens-political-empowerment.csv")
```

```{r}
WPE = clean_names(WPE)
head(WPE[,1:7
])
```

### Check rows and columns

```{r}
#| echo: true
nrow(WPE)
ncol(WPE)

names(WPE)
```

### Remove data

```{r}

# Remove selected entities (don't exist after 1950) 

entity_to_remove <- c(
  "Duchy of Nassau",
  "Hanover",
  "Oldenburg",
  "Piedmont-Sardinia",
  "Saxe-Weimar-Eisenach",
  "Saxony",
  "Wurttemburg"
)


#limit the year from 1950 to 1990
WPE_country_clean <- WPE %>%
  filter(
    !entity %in% entity_to_remove,
    year >= 1950,
    year <= 2025
  )



#Rename Congo to Republic of Congo.
WPE_country_clean <- WPE_country_clean %>%
  mutate(
    entity = recode(
      entity,
      "Congo" = "Republic of Congo",
    )
  )

#Remove 'code' of countries
WPE_country_clean <- WPE_country_clean %>%
  select(entity,year, womens_political_empowerment_overall, womens_civil_liberties, womens_civil_society_participation, womens_political_participation)

View(WPE_country_clean)
```

```{r}
#double-checking
names(WPE_country_clean)
WPE_country_clean %>%
  distinct(entity) %>%
  arrange(entity) %>%
  View()
```

### Check for missing values in cleaned data

```{r}
colSums(is.na(WPE_country_clean))
WPE_country_clean %>%
  filter(if_any(everything(), is.na)) %>%
  View()

#after viewing, the missing data will not interfere with the final graph, so we do not remove
```

Missing Values:

- Bangladesh 1950 - 1968:

  - *NA:* womens_civil_liberties (19)

  - *NA*: womens_political_participation (19)

- Barbados 1951 - 1965:

  - *NA:* womens_civil_liberties (15)

  - *NA*: womens_political_participation (15)

- Central African Republic 1964, 1965:

  - *NA:* womens_civil_liberties (2)

  - *NA*: womens_political_participation (2)

.....

# 2. Visualization World vs Taiwan

## 1) Women's Overall Political Empowerment_Taiwan v.s. World

### Step 1: Prepare data (WPE_plot)

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

WPE_plot <- WPE_country_clean %>%
  filter(
    entity %in% c("World", "Taiwan"),
    year >= 1950,
    year <= 2025
  )
```

### Step 2: Line graph

```{r}
ggplot(WPE_plot, aes(x = year, y = womens_political_empowerment_overall, color = entity)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "World" = "steelblue",
      "Taiwan" = "firebrick"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1950, 2025, by = 5),
    limits = c(1950, 2025)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Women's Political Empowerment: World vs. Taiwan",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Women's Overall Political Empowerment Score",
    color = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

# 3. Plots_Continents Comparison

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| title: Women's Overall Political Empowerment 
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 8

continents <- c(
  "Africa",
  "Asia",
  "Europe",
  "North America",
  "South America",
  "Oceania"
)

WPE_continents <- WPE_country_clean %>%
  filter(
    entity %in% continents,
    year >= 1950,
    year <= 2025
  )



ggplot(
  WPE_continents,
  aes(x = year, y = womens_political_empowerment_overall, color = entity)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(
    data = WPE_continents %>% filter(year == 2025),
    aes(label = entity),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "Africa",
      "Asia",
      "Europe",
      "North America",
      "South America",
      "Oceania"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1950, 2025, by = 5),
    limits = c(1950, 2035)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Women's Political Empowerment Across Five Continents",
    subtitle = "Population-weighted averages, 1950–2025",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Overall Political Empowerment Score",
    color = "Continent",
    size = 15
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 15
    )
  )
```

# 5. Plots_Taiwan v.s. Top 3 Asia

## Overall Political Empowerment

```{r}
WPE_top_asia <- WPE_country_clean %>%
  filter(
    entity %in% c(
      "Taiwan",
      "South Korea",
      "Japan",
      "Philippines"
    ),
    year >= 1950,
    year <= 2025
  )

```

```{r}
WPE_top_asia <- WPE_top_asia %>%
  mutate(
    entity = factor(
      entity,
      levels = c(
        "Taiwan",
        "South Korea",
        "Japan",
        "Philippines"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  WPE_top_asia,
  aes(x = year, y = womens_political_empowerment_overall, color = entity)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Taiwan" = "firebrick",
      "South Korea" = "#00008B",
      "Japan" = "#00CD00", 
      "Philippines" = "#FFFF00"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Taiwan",
      "South Korea",
      "Japan",
      "Philippines"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1950, 2025, by = 5),
    limits = c(1950, 2025)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Women's Political Empowerment: Taiwan v.s. Top 3 Asian Countries",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Overall Political Empowerment Score",
    color = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
